green_release_message: The exhibition ends -- they must let go before things go too far.
flaunt_lines: The predator belches contentedly, showing off for the crowd.
A smug glance to the stands: another meal secured.
They stretch, heavy and pleased with their catch.
The crowd roars as the predator settles their prize.
A lazy lick of the lips -- victory is dinner.
They pat a full middle and smirk at the opposition.
comment: All grapple/vore timing and odds -- tune here, not in code.
